context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 難病/治ら/力不足/カオス/始まら/危うい/宛先/叶わ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、難病の社会的影響、テーマにしましたね。
lines.en: Sakura — you chose rare-disease social impact as your theme.
lines.style: Observant and warm. Opening with her name is a gentle acknowledgment. Clear, measured pace. The kind of teacher who shows she's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。治らない病気を抱える子供、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on children living with incurable illnesses.
lines.style: Direct and earnest. No hedging. Slight lean forward — she wants to be understood. Quiet conviction underneath. Not defensive, just clear about what matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域医療、力不足の現状、章にしましたね。
lines.en: And you made regional healthcare gaps its own chapter — the resource shortages.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Pacing slightly slower, to show real engagement with the work. Warm and genuinely impressed. No performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 感染症発生時のカオス、過去の事例で論じました。
lines.en: I used past outbreak cases to examine what happens when infection spreads in unprepared areas.
lines.style: Measured, methodical. The voice of someone building an argument step by step. Confident but not performed. Breath settling after each clause.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政策がまだ始まらない地域、報告、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: Those regions where policy hasn't even started yet — your report on them was striking.
lines.style: Soft emphasis on 「striking」— real admiration coming through. Pause before the final phrase. The warmth of someone who sees the weight of what the student uncovered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 医療の継続が危うい時、社会も揺れますね。
lines.en: When healthcare itself becomes fragile, the whole society shakes along with it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, deliberate pacing. She's thinking out loud with her teacher, not performing. Small breath after 「fragile」.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 手紙の宛先、行政、丁寧に選びましょう。
lines.en: When you write your letter, choose your recipients in local government carefully.
lines.style: Practical shift, still warm. Light guidance — not instruction. The tone of someone who trusts the student to think it through. Slight rise at the end, like an invitation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夢が叶わぬまま、人は何度も挑戦します。
lines.en: Even when a dream doesn't come true right away, people keep reaching for it again and again.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Slow, almost meditative pacing. This is something she believes. Soft, unbrushed ending — not a conclusion, more like a truth she's handing over.
